dataIdInfo.idAbs: Converts Digital Elevation Model (DEM) rasters to watertight 3D-printable mesh files (STL and 3MF). Contains four tools: DEM to STL and DEM to 3MF for single-DEM conversion, and Split DEM to STL and Split DEM to 3MF for dividing a DEM by a polygon feature class and producing one file per piece at a consistent scale. The 3MF tools support optional multicolor paint layers for use with BambuStudio and compatible AMS printers.
